Where we cater

Across Abu Dhabi, city and islands.

Abu Dhabi city is around an hour and a half's drive from International City, and longer at peak times. We plan cooking, chilling and transport so food arrives on time and is held at a safe temperature until it is served. The earlier you share your date, headcount and serving time, the easier this is to plan, especially for weddings and events with several hundred guests.

  1. Tell us about your event

    Date, venue in Abu Dhabi, headcount and the time you want to serve.

  4. Delivered on time

    Our team brings everything to your venue, with a buffet setup if you want one.

Questions

Catering in Abu Dhabi: good to know.

Do you cater in Abu Dhabi?

Yes. We cater corporate events, weddings, university events and large gatherings across Abu Dhabi, including Khalifa City, Mussafah, Al Reem and Yas Island.

Can you cater a wedding in Abu Dhabi?

Yes. Share your date, venue and guest numbers early and we'll build a menu and delivery plan around your event. Check first whether your venue allows outside catering.

How early should I book catering in Abu Dhabi?

As early as you can. Abu Dhabi is the longest journey from our kitchen, so earlier notice makes it easier to plan the menu, transport and setup.

How is catering in Abu Dhabi priced?

Every quote is custom, based on your headcount, menu, service style and location. Send your date, venue and headcount for a price.

Is your catering halal?

Yes. All our catering menus are 100% halal.
